'''Hyōzu Shrine''' (兵主神社) refers to multiple shrines in Japan. {{Citation needed|date=December 2011|dedicated to the guardian of soldiers (tsuwamonogura)}}.

* [[Hyōzu Taisha]] (officially "Hyōzu Shrine") – Located in [[Yasu City]], [[Shiga Prefecture]], a former [[Prefectural shrines]] and an [[Shikinaisha|ancient Myōjin Taisha]] listed in the [[Engishiki]].
* [[Anashi-Nimasu Hyōzu Shrine]] – Located in [[Sakurai City]], [[Nara Prefecture]], a former Prefectural shrine and an ancient Myōjin Taisha listed in the Engishiki.
* [[Anashinoohohiyauzuno Shrine]]

* [[Hyōzu Shrine (Kishiwada)]] – Located in [[Nishinomachi]], [[Kishiwada City]], [[Osaka Prefecture]], listed in the Engishiki.

* [[Hyōzu Shrine (Tanba)]] – Located in [[Tanba City]], [[Hyōgo Prefecture]], a former Prefectural shrine and listed in the Engishiki.
* [[Hyōzu Shrine|Hyōzu Shrine (Nishiwaki)]] – Located in [[Okazaki, Kuroda, Nishiwaki City]], Hyōgo Prefecture, listed in the Engishiki.
* [[Itatehyōzu Shrine|Itate-Hyōzu Shrines]] – Located in [[Himeji City]], Hyōgo Prefecture, a former Prefectural shrine and listed in the Engishiki.

* [[Hyōzu Shrine (Okayama City)]] – Located in [[Azu, Minami Ward, Okayama City]], [[Okayama Prefecture]].
* [[Hyōzu Shrine (Iki City)]] – Located in [[Fukae, Ashibe Town, Iki City]], [[Nagasaki Prefecture]], a former Prefectural shrine and an ancient Myōjin Taisha listed in the Engishiki.<ref>[[Iki District#Shrines in Iki District|Shrines in Iki District]]</ref>
